prompt: Split the illustration down the middle into two contrasting panels joined by a single thin thread that represents "artificial intelligence" running through both. On the right panel, show a vast, looming abstract silhouette of a machine intelligence, its form dissolving into circuitry that stretches over a barely visible Earth below, with faint cracks or storm clouds suggesting irreversible catastrophe—labeled "hypothetical future." The overall palette should shift from calm, muted tones on the left to darker, more ominous tones on the right, visually encoding the leap from mundane present-day limitations to speculative, civilization-scale stakes without asserting which side is correct.
